# K4-Technology

K4 Technology provides evidence-based gas-engine intelligence, technical due diligence, project economics, equipment review and owner-side engineering for international gas-to-power projects.

## Evidence-Based Gas Engine Technical Due Diligence

Public scopes: Quick Technical Review — USD 450; Full Remote Technical Due Diligence — USD 950; On-Site Technical Inspection — By Quote. Decision states: BUY, BUY WITH CONDITIONS, PRICE ADJUSTMENT, DO NOT BUY.

- Used Jenbacher Buying Guide: https://k4-technology.com/insights/used-jenbacher-buying-guide/
- Gas Engine Technical Due Diligence: https://k4-technology.com/services/gas-engine-technical-due-diligence/
- Quick and full seller requests / inspection checklists: https://k4-technology.com/resources/
- K4 Gas Engine Field Cases: https://k4-technology.com/case-studies/
- Jenbacher J320 Maintenance Cost & Lifecycle: https://k4-technology.com/insights/jenbacher-j320-maintenance-cost-lifecycle/
- How to Verify Operating Hours on a Used Jenbacher — six independent checks covering calendar plausibility, component chronology, service records, energy, controller data and physical wear: https://k4-technology.com/insights/verify-used-jenbacher-operating-hours/
- Jenbacher Borescope Inspection — what visible cylinder evidence can and cannot establish and how to organise a cylinder-by-cylinder review: https://k4-technology.com/insights/jenbacher-borescope-inspection/
- Used Gas Engine Red Flags — twelve acceptance checks for identity, documentation, preservation, condition, completeness and payment hold points: https://k4-technology.com/insights/used-gas-engine-acceptance-red-flags/
- Buying a Used Jenbacher Fleet — unit-by-unit serial, configuration, hours, history and condition verification: https://k4-technology.com/insights/used-jenbacher-fleet-serial-verification/

Evidence labels distinguish OEM DATA, VERIFIED PUBLIC DATA, FIELD EVIDENCE, K4 FIELD DATA, K4 CASE STUDY and K4 ANALYSIS. Missing or seller-reported evidence is not upgraded to fact.
